maximum_borehole_spacing_x_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction
maximum_borehole_spacing_x_m.description: Maximum borehole-to-borehole spacing in x-direction. Units: meters (m).

maximum_borehole_spacing_y_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction
maximum_borehole_spacing_y_m.description: Maximum borehole-to-borehole spacing in y-direction. Units: meters (m).

borehole_removal_method.title: Borehole removal method
borehole_removal_method.description: Defines the method used to remove boreholes from a borefield. This is planned to be an optional parameter for multiple borefield design methods.

thermal_conductivity_w_per_m_k.title: Thermal conductivity
thermal_conductivity_w_per_m_k.description: Thermal conductivity. Units: watts per meter-kelvin (W/m·K).

design_mass_flow_rate_kg_per_s.title: Design mass flow rate
design_mass_flow_rate_kg_per_s.description: Design flow rate. Units: kilograms per second (kg/s).

file_path.title: Load file path
file_path.description: Path to a load data file on the computer running GHEDesigner.

active_borehole_length_m.title: Borehole active length
active_borehole_length_m.description: Length of each borehole. Units: meters (m).

inner_diameter_m.title: Pipe inner diameter
inner_diameter_m.description: Inner diameter of pipe. Units: meters (m).

maximum_entering_fluid_temperature_c.title: Maximum Allowable Entering Fluid Temperature
maximum_entering_fluid_temperature_c.description: Maximum allowable heat pump entering fluid temperature used as a design constraint. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

minimum_entering_fluid_temperature_c.title: Minimum Allowable Entering Fluid Temperature
minimum_entering_fluid_temperature_c.description: Minimum allowable heat pump entering fluid temperature used as a design constraint. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

heating_cop_evaluation_temperature_c.title: Heating COP Evaluation Temperature
heating_cop_evaluation_temperature_c.description: Heat pump entering fluid temperature used to evaluate heating performance when loads are approximated from a performance map. If omitted, GHEDesigner estimates an evaluation temperature from the undisturbed ground temperature. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

cooling_cop_evaluation_temperature_c.title: Cooling COP Evaluation Temperature
cooling_cop_evaluation_temperature_c.description: Heat pump entering fluid temperature used to evaluate cooling performance when loads are approximated from a performance map. If omitted, GHEDesigner estimates an evaluation temperature from the undisturbed ground temperature. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

length_m.title: Length
length_m.description: Horizontal length of property boundary defining surface area available for ground heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

heat_transfer_rate_values_w.title: Hourly load values
heat_transfer_rate_values_w.description: Annual, hourly loads of the object. Positive value indicate heating/heat extraction, negative values indicate cooling/heat rejection. Units: watts (W).

no_go_boundary_coordinates_m.title: No-go boundary coordinates
no_go_boundary_coordinates_m.description: Polygons excluded from the usable property. Units: meters (m).

outer_diameter_m.title: Pipe outer diameter
outer_diameter_m.description: Outer diameter of pipe. Units: meters (m).

values.title: Range definition
values.description: Start value, stop value, and sample count. Units: start and stop use the units of the parameter being varied; sample count is dimensionless.

values.title: Study values
values.description: Explicit values to evaluate. Units: defined by the parameter being varied.

pump_efficiency_fraction.title: Pump efficiency
pump_efficiency_fraction.description: Pump efficiency as a decimal fraction (0-1). Units: dimensionless.

quadratic_coefficient_w_per_c_squared.title: Quadratic coefficient
quadratic_coefficient_w_per_c_squared.description: Quadratic capacity coefficient. Units: W/C squared.

reference_capacity_w.title: Reference capacity
reference_capacity_w.description: Optional reference capacity metadata. Units: watts (W).

volumetric_heat_capacity_j_per_m3_k.title: Volumetric heat capacity
volumetric_heat_capacity_j_per_m3_k.description: Volumetric heat capacity. Units: joules per cubic meter-kelvin (J/m³·K).

ground_temperature_model.title: Seasonal ground temperature model
ground_temperature_model.description: Two-harmonic undisturbed ground-temperature model used for horizontal pipe simulation.

soil.title: Ground properties
soil.description: Ground properties shared by every vertical ground heat exchanger and horizontal pipe in the system.

undisturbed_ground_temperature_c.title: Undisturbed ground temperature
undisturbed_ground_temperature_c.description: Undisturbed, far-field soil temperature. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

surface_roughness_m.title: Pipe surface roughness
surface_roughness_m.description: Surface roughness of pipe. Units: meters (m).

simulation_years.title: System simulation duration
simulation_years.description: Number of years used in system simulation. Units: years.

sizing_years.title: GHE sizing duration
sizing_years.description: Number of years used in ground heat exchanger sizing. Units: years.

shank_spacing_m.title: U-tube shank spacing
shank_spacing_m.description: Spacing between up/down legs of u-tube pipe, as measured from nearest outer surfaces of each pipe (o<-- s -->o). Units: meters (m).

width_m.title: Property width
width_m.description: Horizontal width of property boundary defining surface area available for ground heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

inner_pipe_inner_diameter_m.title: Inner pipe inside diameter
inner_pipe_inner_diameter_m.description: Inner pipe inner diameter. Units: meters (m).

inner_pipe_outer_diameter_m.title: Inner pipe outside diameter
inner_pipe_outer_diameter_m.description: Inner pipe outer diameter. Units: meters (m).

outer_pipe_inner_diameter_m.title: Outer pipe inside diameter
outer_pipe_inner_diameter_m.description: Outer pipe inner diameter. Units: meters (m).

outer_pipe_outer_diameter_m.title: Outer pipe outside diameter
outer_pipe_outer_diameter_m.description: Outer pipe outer diameter. Units: meters (m).

inner_pipe_thermal_conductivity_w_per_m_.title: Inner-pipe thermal conductivity
inner_pipe_thermal_conductivity_w_per_m_.description: Thermal conductivity of inner pipe. Units: watts per meter-kelvin (W/m·K).

outer_pipe_thermal_conductivity_w_per_m_.title: Outer-pipe thermal conductivity
outer_pipe_thermal_conductivity_w_per_m_.description: Thermal conductivity of outer pipe. Units: watts per meter-kelvin (W/m·K).

passive_hydraulics.title: Passive hydraulics
passive_hydraulics.description: Passive pressure loss. A paired reference design point defines a quadratic loss curve when physical pipe geometry is not applicable.

network_segment.title: Network segment
network_segment.description: A physical distribution segment between consecutive compact-network stations.

mass_flow_control.title: Mass-flow control
mass_flow_control.description: One-pipe distribution-flow control used to prescribe circulation independently of pressure loss.

stations.title: Ordered physical components
stations.description: Components in physical distribution order. Each network component must appear exactly once.

network.title: Distribution network
network.description: A one-pipe or two-pipe unidirectional district distribution network.

concentration_percent.title: Antifreeze concentration
concentration_percent.description: Mass fraction concentration percent of circulation fluid. e.g.: '0' indicates pure water; '20' indicates 20% antifreeze, 80% pure water. Units: percent by mass (%).

property_evaluation_temperature_c.title: Fluid property temperature
property_evaluation_temperature_c.description: Average design fluid temperature at peak conditions. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

heat_pumps.title: Heat pump performance maps
heat_pumps.description: A collection of data that define a heat pump.

buildings.title: Buildings and heat pump loads
buildings.description: Installed heat pump and building-load components referenced by the ordered district network.

ground_heat_exchangers.title: Ground heat exchangers
ground_heat_exchangers.description: Ground heat exchanger components. Optional hydraulics define a component-level pressure loss.

design_volumetric_flow_rate_per_borehole.title: Design flow per borehole
design_volumetric_flow_rate_per_borehole.description: Volumetric design flow rate per borehole. Units: liters per second (L/s).

circulation_pump.title: Circulation pump
circulation_pump.description: GHE-internal circulation pump, hydraulically separate from network flow. Required for every GHE in a one-pipe network.

reference_pressure_drop_pa.title: Reference pressure drop
reference_pressure_drop_pa.description: Pressure loss at the GHE design flow for the borefield and its local headers only; distribution piping is excluded. Units: pascals (Pa).

pressure_drop_multiplier.title: Pressure-drop multiplier
pressure_drop_multiplier.description: Multiplicative factor applied to the reference pressure drop. Units: dimensionless.

top_depth_below_grade_m.title: Borehole burial depth
top_depth_below_grade_m.description: Depth of top of borehole below the ground surface. Units: meters (m).

fixed_borefield.title: Pre-designed borefield
fixed_borefield.description: Data related to a pre-designed borehole field, used in cases where the field arrangement is known ahead of time. GHEDesigner will provide a g-function calculation for the specified field.

borefield_plan_area_m2.title: Borefield plan area
borefield_plan_area_m2.description: Effective top-down area associated with this manual borefield. Used only by the penalty baseline in specialized multi-GHE sizing; it does not affect g-function generation or normal district simulation. Units: square meters (m²).

borehole_count_x.title: Number of boreholes in the x direction
borehole_count_x.description: Number of boreholes in the x direction of the field. Units: dimensionless.

borehole_count_y.title: Number of boreholes in the y direction
borehole_count_y.description: Number of boreholes in the y direction of the field. Units: dimensionless.

borehole_spacing_x_m.title: Borehole spacing in the x direction
borehole_spacing_x_m.description: Borehole spacing in the x direction of the field, in meters (ignored if boreholes_in_x_dimension = 1). Units: meters (m).

borehole_spacing_y_m.title: Borehole spacing in the y direction
borehole_spacing_y_m.description: Borehole spacing in the y direction of the field, in meters (ignored if boreholes_in_y_dimension = 1). Units: meters (m).

maximum_borehole_spacing_x_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction

maximum_borehole_spacing_y_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction

maximum_borehole_spacing_x_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction

maximum_borehole_spacing_y_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction

maximum_borehole_spacing_x_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the x direction

maximum_borehole_spacing_y_m.title: Maximum borehole spacing in the y direction

minimum_borehole_spacing_m.title: Minimum row spacing
minimum_borehole_spacing_m.description: The smallest minimum spacing that will be used to generate a RowWise field. Units: meters (m).

maximum_borehole_spacing_m.title: Maximum row spacing
maximum_borehole_spacing_m.description: The largest minimum spacing that will be used to generate a RowWise field. Units: meters (m).

borehole_spacing_step_m.title: Row spacing increment
borehole_spacing_step_m.description: The distance in spacing from the design found in the first part of first search to exhaustively check in the second part. Units: meters (m).

minimum_rotation_degrees.title: Minimum row rotation
minimum_rotation_degrees.description: The minimum rotation of the rows of each field relative to horizontal that will be used in the search. Units: degrees (°).

maximum_rotation_degrees.title: Maximum row rotation
maximum_rotation_degrees.description: The maximum rotation of the rows of each field relative to horizontal that will be used in the search. Units: degrees (°).

rotation_step_degrees.title: Row rotation increment
rotation_step_degrees.description: Step size for field rotation search. Units: degrees (°).

perimeter_spacing_ratio.title: Perimeter spacing ratio
perimeter_spacing_ratio.description: The ratio between the minimum spacing between boreholes placed along the property and no-go zones and the standard borehole-to-borehole spacing used for internal boreholes. Units: dimensionless.

maximum_borehole_count.title: Maximum number of boreholes
maximum_borehole_count.description: Maximum number of boreholes in search. Optional. Applies to rectangular and near-square design algorithms. If unspecified, the search space will be bounded by the size of the GHE boundary. Units: dimensionless.

continue_if_design_unmet.title: Continue when design limits are unmet
continue_if_design_unmet.description: Causes to return the best available borehole field configuration rather than fail if design conditions are unmet. Optional. Default False.

maximum_active_borehole_length_m.title: Maximum borehole active length
maximum_active_borehole_length_m.description: Maximum height, or active length, of each borehole heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

minimum_active_borehole_length_m.title: Minimum borehole active length
minimum_active_borehole_length_m.description: Minimum height, or active length, of each borehole heat exchanger. Units: meters (m).

parametric_study.title: Parametric study
parametric_study.description: Contains controls related to running parametric studies on network design.

ground_heat_exchanger_ids_to_modify.title: Ground heat exchangers to modify
ground_heat_exchanger_ids_to_modify.description: List of GHEs to use in study. Not including this will assume that all GHEs are to be modified.

items.description: Name of a network GHE whose properties are changed during the study.

minimum_entering_fluid_temperature_modif.title: Minimum entering-fluid temperature modifications
minimum_entering_fluid_temperature_modif.description: The amount that buildings' minimum design temperature is modified in the study.

maximum_entering_fluid_temperature_modif.title: Maximum entering-fluid temperature modifications
maximum_entering_fluid_temperature_modif.description: The amount that buildings' maximum design temperature is modified in the study.

grout_thermal_conductivities_w_per_m_k.title: Grout conductivities
grout_thermal_conductivities_w_per_m_k.description: The grout conductivities to be explored in the study.

pipe_inner_outer_diameters_m.title: Pipe sizes
pipe_inner_outer_diameters_m.description: The ghe pipe sizes to use during the study. The internal and external diameters must be specified.

borehole_active_lengths_m.title: Borehole active lengths
borehole_active_lengths_m.description: The GHE borehole active lengths to be explored during the study.

updated_topology.title: Updated network station order
updated_topology.description: A list of potential changes to make to the system's network station order.

items.description: Pairs of strings describing which station to move and which station should precede it: (element_to_move, new_preceding_element).

load_method.title: Load time-step method
load_method.description: Load method used for simulations and sizing. HYBRID aggregates loads before GHE calculations; HOURLY uses hourly loads directly.

search_method.title: System GHE search method
search_method.description: Defines the type of design method to be used for the system GHEs. Use "SIMULATION_ONLY" if you only want to simulate pre-designed GHEs.

constant_cop.title: Use constant COP
constant_cop.description: Determines if system heat pump loads are converted with fixed COP behavior instead of full heat pump performance calculations.

exhaustive_search.title: Use exhaustive search
exhaustive_search.description: Determines if the GHE design algorithm will perform an exhaustive search or a faster search (which depends on the search method type).

horizontal_segments.title: Horizontal pipe segments
horizontal_segments.description: Number of segments for horizontal buried pipe simulations. Units: dimensionless.

horizontal_simulation_considered.title: Include horizontal pipe heat transfer
horizontal_simulation_considered.description: Determines if the simulation accounts for thermal effects from horizontal_piping components using soil.ground_temperature_model.

source_sink_heat_exchangers.title: Source and sink heat exchangers
source_sink_heat_exchangers.description: Source/sink heat exchanger components. Optional hydraulics define a component-level pressure loss.

cut_in_temperature_c.title: Cut-in temperature
cut_in_temperature_c.description: Start threshold applied to the heat exchanger inlet temperature at the beginning of a timestep. A source starts below this value; a sink starts above it. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

cut_out_temperature_c.title: Cut-out temperature
cut_out_temperature_c.description: Stop threshold applied to the heat exchanger inlet temperature at the beginning of a timestep. A source stops above this value; a sink stops below it. A cut-out above cut-in defines a source; the reverse defines a sink. Units: degrees Celsius (°C).

schema_version.title: Input schema version
schema_version.description: GHEDesigner input schema version. Only version 3 is supported. Units: dimensionless.

horizontal_piping.title: Horizontal piping models
horizontal_piping.description: Collection of data for horizontal piping objects.
